name: answer-for-me
description: Stand in for the user while they step away: answer this project's other Claude Code sessions the way the user would, including their multiple-choice question dialogs (a hook offers each open dialog to the stand-in, even one opened before it went on duty), land the work the user approved (commit, push, migrate), and report what only the user can do. Runs only when you type /answer-for-me.
